system.description:
You wield strength so colossal that bone shatters and stone splits beneath your hands; only the suicidal or the insane would cross you in a test of might, for the blow that connects is very often the last one your foe ever feels.

You are so dangerous in hand-to-hand combat that you inflict two additional wounds whenever you win the challenge. If your opponent also uses Demolition, and each of you wins one of the tests, you both take full damage.
